caption: The drawing depicts a stylized rooster, oriented to the left, rendered in shades of grey on a light beige or off-white background. The rooster has a prominent, rounded body, with detailed feather patterns on its wings, neck, and tail. The tail is exaggerated in size, fanning out behind with textured, wavy lines and segmentations. The rooster's comb is rounded and features a vertical rectangular extension at the top, and the beak is open. Its legs are short and cylindrical, with one leg appearing thicker and more simplified as a vertical tube, while the other leg is more naturalistic and ends in three toes. The drawing is enclosed within a faint rectangular border, with a small scale for measurement in the lower left corner and the signature "Edlington Campbell" in the lower right corner. The composition is monochromatic, utilizing pencil shading and hatching to define the form and bevels of the rooster.
title: Weather Vane - Cock
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
